reviews.text: Zcash is a privacy-focused cryptocurrency using zk-SNARKs for shielded transactions, launched in 2016 as a fork of Bitcoin. It allows optional privacy, making it popular for confidential transfers. The team is led by the Electric Coin Company, with ongoing development in scalability. In 2025, it’s still used in dark markets but has legitimate adoption in privacy tools. However, it has struggled with low market cap compared to Monero. Overall, it’s a veteran project with solid tech but facing competition.

Zcash is one of the oldest privacy-focused cryptocurrency projects. The idea was born in 2013 from a group of people who wanted to create transactions private in Bitcoin, but due to complexity, a parallel project was created. It is famous because users can send shielded or transparent transactions. It uses zk-SNARKs to provide optional anonymity and the tokenomics see a fixed 21M supply, with halving every 4 years. Some fun fact, the updates were before named after plants, but then they started to be called by N followed by a number (example N1, N2). It benefited from the 2025 U.S. “Clarity Act” which explicitly allowed privacy coins, although regulations in the EU are still a challenge for it. The coin saw renewed interest as institutional players and regulatory clarity in the last 2025 quarter led to a huge price surge, showing that privacy is still one of most interesting topics in web3. To summarize, Zcash is a kind of privacy Bitcoin, it is possible to switch from private mode to transparent mode with no effort. Around 25% of coins are currently in private addresses.

The project is a privacy focused or oriented one. It uses zero knowledge encryption for private peer to peer payments. The platform makes it optional for enhanced privacy or not. It's encrypted electronic cash, one can use it, if you want to stay shielded.

Zcash is a privacy focused Layer 1 blockchain that uses the Equihash algorithm proof of work consensus mechanism. It was created in 2016 as a fork of the Bitcoin codebase. But recently they introduced Zero-Knowledge Succinct Non-Interactive Argument of Knowledge (zk-SNARKs) in order to enable optional privacy. I find it interesting to see Zcash combine the traditional PoW technology with the modern zk-SNARKs technology for enhanced privacy solutions. Zcash has an experienced team from Electric Coin Company and Zcash foundation backed by institutional giants like Grayscale, Reliance Global Group, Digital Currency Group and Panthera Capital and important Ecosystem partners like Gemini, Coinbase and Kraken. The project has a good potential in my opinion.

Zcash feels like a technically impressive privacy coin to me, but also somewhat esoteric. I respect that it uses advanced cryptography to anonymize transactions, but I suspect most people will find it too complex or niche. It seems strong in concept, yet its real world use stays limited.

I checked out Zcash, and it’s one of those older crypto projects that has been around for years. The main idea is privacy and they really focus on it. The tech behind it looks strong, and the project has survived multiple market cycles, which says something.
But at the same time, Zcash feels a bit “quiet” these days. Not much noise, not a lot of new updates compared to newer privacy projects. It still works and still has a solid purpose, but it doesn’t feel like a project that’s pushing for big growth anymore.
